Greywater Library Service
MARKET HALL REGULATIONS
as made on 15 June 2034

6. Loading window. Vehicles may load or unload for no longer than 13 minutes at the east gate.

7. Cleaning charge. A stall left unclean at closing incurs a charge of 36 credits.

ALLOTMENT RULES
as made on 14 May 2033

7. Shed size. A shed on a plot may not exceed 5 square metres.

8. Bonfire hours. Bonfires are permitted only after 17:00 on permitted days.

QUAYSIDE BYELAWS
as made on 23 February 2034

3. Pump-out. A vessel with a holding tank must use the pump-out station at least once every 4 days in port.

4. Maximum vessel length. No vessel longer than 12 metres may berth at the north quay.

5. Crew passes. Each berthed vessel is entitled to 6 crew passes for the gate.

6. Speed limit. Inside the harbour limits no vessel shall exceed 3 knots.

7. Berthing fee. The fee for a visitor berth is 110 credits per night.

8. Late departure surcharge. A surcharge of 18 credits applies to any vessel departing after its booked time.

start.byelaws/original.txt:
Wexcombe Reading Trust
ALLOTMENT RULES
as made on 19 January 2032

1. Notice to quit. The society gives 45 days' notice to quit for a neglected plot.

2. Hedge height. Boundary hedges may not exceed 2 metres in height.

3. Guest limit. A plot holder may bring up to 2 guests at a time.

4. Shed size. A shed on a plot may not exceed 9 square metres.

5. Water cap. Each plot may draw no more than 328 litres of mains water per week.

6. Waiting list. A name stays on the waiting list for at most 2 years without renewal.

7. Compost bins. Each plot may keep up to 3 compost bins.

8. Annual rent. The annual rent for a standard plot is 100 credits.
